analysis.summary: Management reported a standalone revenue from operations of ₹ 1,173.25 Lakhs and a standalone net profit of ₹ 3,753.55 Lakhs for the financial year ended March 31, 2026. The consolidated revenues from operations increased to ₹ 11,642.04 Lakhs, with consolidated net profit reaching ₹ 6,853.79 Lakhs. The Board decided to retain current year profits to support planned capital expenditures and did not recommend any dividend for the financial year. The company also detailed strategic expansions, asset deployment of the Prabha DP2 barge, and related party transaction approvals through the annual report. Dolphin Offshore Enterprises (India) Limited submitted its Annual Report for the financial year 2024-25, detailing operational highlights, financial results, board changes, and corporate governance practices.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for Platform Supply Vessels is currently high due to increased activity on offshore oil and gas platforms.
demand_outlook.quote: Platform Supply Vessels (PSVs) are currently in high demand due to increased activity on offshore oil and gas platforms.

demand_outlook.claim: The medium-term outlook for the offshore services sector remains favourable, supported by sustained offshore investment, increasing demand for specialised marine assets and limited fleet additions.
demand_outlook.quote: The medium-term outlook for the offshore services sector remains favourable, supported by sustained offshore investment, increasing demand for specialised marine assets and limited fleet additions.

demand_outlook.claim: The contract tenures for Platform Supply Vessels and Anchor Handling Tug Supply vessels generally range from 1 to 5 years, providing stable and predictable revenue.
demand_outlook.quote: The contract tenures for Platform Supply Vessels (PSVs) and Anchor Handling Tug Supply (AHTS) vessels generally range from 1 to 5 years, providing Dolphin Offshore Enterprises with a stable and predictable revenue stream.

demand_outlook.claim: India is projected to assume the position of the world's largest source of oil demand growth this decade.
demand_outlook.quote: As energy transitions gather pace and China’s economy shifts gear towards a less energy-intensive phase, India will assume the position as the world’s largest source of oil demand growth this decade.

demand_outlook.claim: The market is expected to remain buoyant as ONGC proposes high-value tenders in brown and green fields.
demand_outlook.quote: The market is expected to remain buoyant in the coming years as ONGC proposes to come out with many high value tenders in brown & green fields.

demand_outlook.claim: Platform Supply Vessels are in high demand following robust activities on offshore platforms.
demand_outlook.quote: PSV are in high demand following robust activities on offshore platforms.

capex_expansion.claim: Dolphin Offshore Enterprises is planning a capital investment of approximately 500 crore over the next 12 to 15 months to acquire two DSVs or PSVs and two Anchor Handling Tug Supply vessels.
capex_expansion.quote: In response to this market opportunity, Dolphin Offshore Enterprises (India) Limited is planning a capital investment of approximately ₹500 crore over the next 12 to 15 months to acquire two DSVs/PSVs & two Anchor Handling Tug Supply (AHTS) vessels.

capex_expansion.claim: Beluga International DMCC owns the DP2 accommodation work barge Prabha with a capacity of 275 people.
capex_expansion.quote: Prabha is a Dynamically Positioned Vessel (DP2) accommodation Work Barge with a capacity of 275 People, Deck Space of 1200 sq. meter and 450 ton crore and the same is owned by Beluga International DMCC.

capex_expansion.claim: Beluga International DMCC was incorporated in December 2023 in UAE, Dubai for ship charter and leasing activities.
capex_expansion.quote: BELUGA was incorporated in December 2023 in UAE, Dubai.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has two Saturation Diving systems.
orders_capacity.quote: Your Company has two (2) Saturation Diving systems.

capital_allocation.claim: The company seeks member approval to advance loans, give guarantees, or provide security up to an aggregate sum of Rs. 300 Crores.
capital_allocation.quote: upto an aggregate sum of ` 300 Crores (Rupees Three Hundred Crores Only) in their absolute discretion deem beneficial and in the interest of the Company, provided that such loans are utilized by the borrower companies for its principal business activities.

risks_headwinds.claim: Political unrest and war in the Middle East resulted in closure of the Straits of Hormuz and disruptions in productions from oil and gas fields and refineries.
risks_headwinds.quote: political unrest and war in the Middle East resulting in closure of the Straits of Hormuz and disruptions in productions from oil and gas fields and refineries..

risks_headwinds.claim: Fluctuations in oil prices can lead to reduced demand for vessels, affecting profitability.
risks_headwinds.quote: Volatility in Oil Prices: Offshore vessels heavily rely on the oil and gas industry. Fluctuations in oil prices can lead to reduced demand for vessels, affecting profitability.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global economic slowdowns can lead to reduced investment in offshore projects, leading to lower utilization rates for offshore vessels.
risks_headwinds.quote: Economic Downturns: Global economic slowdowns can lead to reduced investment in offshore projects, leading to lower utilization rates for offshore vessels.

risks_headwinds.claim: Collisions, groundings, or accidents can result in significant financial losses and environmental damage.
risks_headwinds.quote: Accidents and Collisions: Offshore operations are complex and hazardous. Collisions, groundings, or accidents can result in significant financial losses and environmental damage.

risks_headwinds.claim: Adverse weather and harsh sea conditions can disrupt operations, damage vessels, and pose safety risks.
risks_headwinds.quote: Adverse weather and harsh sea conditions can disrupt operations, damage vessels, and pose safety risks to crew members.
